summary: Defers superagent's real .end() until the implicit server is confirmed listening (or reports a start error), then runs it and decrements a shared pending-request count, closing the server only once every concurrent request against it has settled. This function's real history is the most consequential in the file: a 2025 attempt at automatic server closing had to be reverted per issue #651 after it broke manually-started-server usage, and the September 2026 stabilization commit fixed four more real issues against this exact lifecycle logic.
